def dot_last(left,right):
 return np.sum(left*right,axis=-1)

def point_segment_sq(point,start,end):

 denom=dot_last(direction,direction)

 parameter=np.clip(parameter,0,1)
 residual=point-start-parameter[...,None]*direction
 return dot_last(residual,residual)

 offset=point-start

 pa=dot_last(offset,side_a); pb=dot_last(offset,side_b)

 coord_b=np.divide(aa*pb-ab*pa,denom,out=np.zeros_like(pb),where=denom>0)

 plane_sq=np.divide(signed*signed,normal_sq,out=np.full_like(signed,np.inf),where=normal_sq>0)

def dot_rows(left,right):
 return np.sum(left*right,axis=-1)
def point_segment_sq(points,start,end):
 direction=end-start
 parameter=np.clip(dot_rows(points-start,direction)/dot_rows(direction,direction),0,1)
 residual=points-start-parameter[...,None]*direction
 return dot_rows(residual,residual)
def point_triangle_sq(points,triangles):
 origin=triangles[:,0]; edge_u=triangles[:,1]-origin; edge_v=triangles[:,2]-origin
 normal=np.cross(edge_u,edge_v); normal_sq=dot_rows(normal,normal)
 offset=points-origin
 height=dot_rows(offset,normal)
 projected=offset-height[:,None]/normal_sq[:,None]*normal
 uu=dot_rows(edge_u,edge_u); uv=dot_rows(edge_u,edge_v); vv=dot_rows(edge_v,edge_v)
 pu=dot_rows(projected,edge_u); pv=dot_rows(projected,edge_v)
 determinant=dot_rows(normal,normal)
 bary_u=(pu*vv-pv*uv)/determinant
 bary_v=(pv*uu-pu*uv)/determinant
 inside=(bary_u>=0)&(bary_v>=0)&(bary_u+bary_v<=1)
 distance=np.minimum.reduce([point_segment_sq(points,triangles[:,idx],triangles[:,(idx+1)%3]) for idx in range(3)])
 return np.where(inside,np.minimum(distance,height*height/normal_sq),distance)
def segments_sq(start_a,end_a,start_b,end_b):
 direction_a=end_a-start_a;direction_b=end_b-start_b;offset=start_a-start_b
 aa=dot_rows(direction_a,direction_a);bb=dot_rows(direction_a,direction_b);cc=dot_rows(direction_b,direction_b)
 dd=dot_rows(direction_a,offset);ee=dot_rows(direction_b,offset)
 determinant=aa*cc-bb*bb
 stable=determinant>1e-14*aa*cc
 safe=np.where(stable,determinant,1)
 param_a=(bb*ee-cc*dd)/safe;param_b=(aa*ee-bb*dd)/safe
 interior=stable&(param_a>=0)&(param_a<=1)&(param_b>=0)&(param_b<=1)
 residual=offset+param_a[:,None]*direction_a-param_b[:,None]*direction_b
 endpoint=np.minimum.reduce([point_segment_sq(start_a,start_b,end_b),point_segment_sq(end_a,start_b,end_b),point_segment_sq(start_b,start_a,end_a),point_segment_sq(end_b,start_a,end_a)])
 return np.where(interior,np.minimum(endpoint,dot_rows(residual,residual)),endpoint)
def segment_triangle_hit(start,end,triangles):
 origin=triangles[:,0];edge_u=triangles[:,1]-origin;edge_v=triangles[:,2]-origin
 normal=np.cross(edge_u,edge_v);direction=end-start
 denominator=dot_rows(direction,normal)
 valid=np.abs(denominator)>1e-14*np.sqrt(dot_rows(direction,direction)*dot_rows(normal,normal))
 parameter=dot_rows(origin-start,normal)/np.where(valid,denominator,1)
 point=start+parameter[:,None]*direction
 offset=point-origin
 determinant=dot_rows(normal,normal)
 uu=dot_rows(edge_u,edge_u);uv=dot_rows(edge_u,edge_v);vv=dot_rows(edge_v,edge_v)
 pu=dot_rows(offset,edge_u);pv=dot_rows(offset,edge_v)
 bary_u=(pu*vv-pv*uv)/determinant;bary_v=(pv*uu-pu*uv)/determinant
 return valid&(parameter>=0)&(parameter<=1)&(bary_u>=0)&(bary_v>=0)&(bary_u+bary_v<=1)
def surface_distance(tris_a,tris_b):
 count_a,count_b=len(tris_a),len(tris_b)
 repeated_a=np.repeat(tris_a,count_b,axis=0);repeated_b=np.tile(tris_b,(count_a,1,1))
 hits=np.zeros(len(repeated_a),dtype=bool)
 for edge_idx in range(3):
  hits|=segment_triangle_hit(repeated_a[:,edge_idx],repeated_a[:,(edge_idx+1)%3],repeated_b)
  hits|=segment_triangle_hit(repeated_b[:,edge_idx],repeated_b[:,(edge_idx+1)%3],repeated_a)
 if hits.any():return 0.0,True
 best=np.full(len(repeated_a),np.inf)
 for vertex_idx in range(3):
  best=np.minimum(best,point_triangle_sq(repeated_a[:,vertex_idx],repeated_b))
  best=np.minimum(best,point_triangle_sq(repeated_b[:,vertex_idx],repeated_a))
 for edge_a in range(3):

 return float(np.sqrt(best.min())),False

depsgraph=bpy.context.evaluated_depsgraph_get()
objs=[obj for obj in scene.objects if obj.type=='MESH']
geometry=[]
for obj in objs:
 evaluated=obj.evaluated_get(depsgraph)
 mesh=evaluated.to_mesh()
 try:
  mesh.calc_loop_triangles()
  transform=np.array(evaluated.matrix_world,dtype=np.float64)
  vertices=np.array([vertex.co[:] for vertex in mesh.vertices],dtype=np.float64).reshape((-1,3))
  world=vertices@transform[:3,:3].T+transform[:3,3]
  indices=np.array([triangle.vertices[:] for triangle in mesh.loop_triangles],dtype=np.int64).reshape((-1,3))
  geometry.append({'name':obj.name,'tri':world[indices]})
 finally:evaluated.to_mesh_clear()
mm_per_unit=scene.unit_settings.scale_length*1000
threshold=2/mm_per_unit
print('units',scene.unit_settings.system,'scale',scene.unit_settings.scale_length,'mesh_count',len(objs),'triangles',sum(len(item['tri']) for item in geometry))
print('empty',[item['name'] for item in geometry if not len(item['tri'])])
print('distance_function_available','surface_distance' in globals())
print('degenerates',[(item['name'],int(np.sum(np.linalg.norm(np.cross(item['tri'][:,1]-item['tri'][:,0],item['tri'][:,2]-item['tri'][:,0]),axis=1)==0))) for item in geometry if len(item['tri']) and np.any(np.linalg.norm(np.cross(item['tri'][:,1]-item['tri'][:,0],item['tri'][:,2]-item['tri'][:,0]),axis=1)==0)])
all_results=[]
for first in range(len(geometry)):
 for second in range(first+1,len(geometry)):
  if not len(geometry[first]['tri']) or not len(geometry[second]['tri']):continue
  distance,hit=surface_distance(geometry[first]['tri'],geometry[second]['tri'])
  all_results.append((first,second,distance,hit))
qualifying=[record for record in all_results if record[2]<=threshold]
print('checked',len(all_results),'qualifying',len(qualifying))
for first,second,distance,hit in qualifying:print(geometry[first]['name'],geometry[second]['name'],format(distance*mm_per_unit,'.9f'),'hit',hit)
print('nearest_excluded_mm',min((record[2]*mm_per_unit for record in all_results if record[2]>threshold),default=None))

scene=bpy.context.scene
depsgraph=bpy.context.evaluated_depsgraph_get()
objs=[obj for obj in scene.objects if obj.type=='MESH']
geometry=[]
for obj in objs:
 evaluated=obj.evaluated_get(depsgraph)
 mesh=evaluated.to_mesh()
 try:
  mesh.calc_loop_triangles()
  transform=np.array(evaluated.matrix_world,dtype=np.float64)
  vertices=np.array([vertex.co[:] for vertex in mesh.vertices],dtype=np.float64).reshape((-1,3))
  world=vertices@transform[:3,:3].T+transform[:3,3]
  indices=np.array([triangle.vertices[:] for triangle in mesh.loop_triangles],dtype=np.int64).reshape((-1,3))
  geometry.append({'name':obj.name,'tri':world[indices]})
 finally:evaluated.to_mesh_clear()
mm_per_unit=scene.unit_settings.scale_length*1000
threshold=2/mm_per_unit
print('units',scene.unit_settings.system,'scale',scene.unit_settings.scale_length,'mesh_count',len(objs),'triangles',sum(len(item['tri']) for item in geometry))
print('empty',[item['name'] for item in geometry if not len(item['tri'])])
print('degenerates',[(item['name'],int(np.sum(np.linalg.norm(np.cross(item['tri'][:,1]-item['tri'][:,0],item['tri'][:,2]-item['tri'][:,0]),axis=1)==0))) for item in geometry if len(item['tri']) and np.any(np.linalg.norm(np.cross(item['tri'][:,1]-item['tri'][:,0],item['tri'][:,2]-item['tri'][:,0]),axis=1)==0)])
all_results=[]
for first in range(len(geometry)):
 for second in range(first+1,len(geometry)):
  if not len(geometry[first]['tri']) or not len(geometry[second]['tri']):continue
  distance,hit=surface_distance(geometry[first]['tri'],geometry[second]['tri'])
  all_results.append((first,second,distance,hit))
qualifying=[record for record in all_results if record[2]<=threshold]
print('checked',len(all_results),'qualifying',len(qualifying))
for first,second,distance,hit in qualifying:print(geometry[first]['name'],geometry[second]['name'],format(distance*mm_per_unit,'.9f'),'hit',hit)
print('nearest_excluded_mm',min((record[2]*mm_per_unit for record in all_results if record[2]>threshold),default=None))

deps=bpy.context.evaluated_depsgraph_get()
meshes=[]
for obj in sc.objects:
    if obj.type!='MESH': continue
    ev=obj.evaluated_get(deps)
    mesh=ev.to_mesh()
    mesh.calc_loop_triangles()
    coords=np.array([tuple(v.co) for v in mesh.vertices],dtype=np.float64)
    matrix=np.array(ev.matrix_world,dtype=np.float64)
    coords=coords@matrix[:3,:3].T+matrix[:3,3]
    indices=np.array([tuple(t.vertices) for t in mesh.loop_triangles],dtype=np.int64).reshape(-1,3)
    triangles=coords[indices]
    meshes.append(dict(name=obj.name,tri=triangles,lo=triangles.min(axis=(0,1)) if len(triangles) else None,hi=triangles.max(axis=(0,1)) if len(triangles) else None))
    ev.to_mesh_clear()
print('MESHES',[(m['name'],len(m['tri']),m['lo'].tolist() if m['lo'] is not None else None,m['hi'].tolist() if m['hi'] is not None else None) for m in meshes])
threshold=.002/sc.unit_settings.scale_length
candidates=[]
for i,a in enumerate(meshes):
    for j in range(i+1,len(meshes)):
        b=meshes[j]
        if a['lo'] is None or b['lo'] is None: continue
        delta=np.maximum(0,np.maximum(a['lo']-b['hi'],b['lo']-a['hi']))
        bound=np.linalg.norm(delta)
        if bound<=threshold: candidates.append((i,j,float(bound)))
print('CANDIDATES',len(candidates),[(meshes[i]['name'],meshes[j]['name'],d*1000) for i,j,d in candidates])

def dotvec(a,b): return np.einsum('...i,...i->...',a,b)
def tri_pair_distances(first,second):
    count=len(first)*len(second)
    aa=np.repeat(first,len(second),axis=0)
    bb=np.tile(second,(len(first),1,1))
    best=np.full(count,np.inf)
    def point_faces(points,faces):
        origin=faces[:,0]; edge_u=faces[:,1]-origin; edge_v=faces[:,2]-origin
        normal=np.cross(edge_u,edge_v); norm2=dotvec(normal,normal)
        offset=points-origin
        signed=dotvec(offset,normal)
        projection=points-normal*np.divide(signed,norm2,out=np.zeros_like(signed),where=norm2>0)[:,None]
        return projection,signed,norm2
    def inside(points,faces):
        edge_u=faces[:,1]-faces[:,0]; edge_v=faces[:,2]-faces[:,0]; offset=points-faces[:,0]
        normal=np.cross(edge_u,edge_v); denom=dotvec(normal,normal)
        bary_u=np.divide(dotvec(np.cross(offset,edge_v),normal),denom,out=np.full(count,np.nan),where=denom>0)
        bary_v=np.divide(dotvec(np.cross(edge_u,offset),normal),denom,out=np.full(count,np.nan),where=denom>0)
        return (bary_u>=-1e-13)&(bary_v>=-1e-13)&(bary_u+bary_v<=1+1e-13)
    for source,target in ((aa,bb),(bb,aa)):
        for vertex in range(3):
            projected,signed,norm2=point_faces(source[:,vertex],target)
            dist2=np.divide(signed*signed,norm2,out=np.full(count,np.inf),where=norm2>0)
            best=np.minimum(best,np.where(inside(projected,target),dist2,np.inf))
        normal=np.cross(target[:,1]-target[:,0],target[:,2]-target[:,0])
        for edge in range(3):
            start=source[:,edge]; end=source[:,(edge+1)%3]; direction=end-start
            denom=dotvec(direction,normal)
            param=np.divide(dotvec(target[:,0]-start,normal),denom,out=np.full(count,np.nan),where=denom!=0)
            hit=start+np.nan_to_num(param)[:,None]*direction
            intersects=(param>=0)&(param<=1)&inside(hit,target)
            best=np.where(intersects,0,best)
    for edge_a in range(3):
        start_a=aa[:,edge_a]; direction_a=aa[:,(edge_a+1)%3]-start_a
        for edge_b in range(3):
            start_b=bb[:,edge_b]; direction_b=bb[:,(edge_b+1)%3]-start_b
            offset=start_a-start_b
            length_a=dotvec(direction_a,direction_a); length_b=dotvec(direction_b,direction_b)
            mixed=dotvec(direction_a,direction_b); offset_a=dotvec(direction_a,offset); offset_b=dotvec(direction_b,offset)
            denom=dotvec(np.cross(direction_a,direction_b),np.cross(direction_a,direction_b))
            param_a=np.divide(mixed*offset_b-length_b*offset_a,denom,out=np.full(count,np.nan),where=denom>0)
            param_b=np.divide(length_a*offset_b-mixed*offset_a,denom,out=np.full(count,np.nan),where=denom>0)
            delta=offset+np.nan_to_num(param_a)[:,None]*direction_a-np.nan_to_num(param_b)[:,None]*direction_b
            best=np.minimum(best,np.where((param_a>=0)&(param_a<=1)&(param_b>=0)&(param_b<=1),dotvec(delta,delta),np.inf))
            for endpoint in (0,1):

import bpy, numpy as np, time
sc=bpy.context.scene
deps=bpy.context.evaluated_depsgraph_get()
meshes=[]
for obj in sc.objects:
    if obj.type!='MESH': continue
    ev=obj.evaluated_get(deps)
    mesh=ev.to_mesh()
    mesh.calc_loop_triangles()
    coords=np.array([tuple(v.co) for v in mesh.vertices],dtype=np.float64).reshape(-1,3)
    matrix=np.array(ev.matrix_world,dtype=np.float64)
    coords=coords@matrix[:3,:3].T+matrix[:3,3]
    indices=np.array([tuple(t.vertices) for t in mesh.loop_triangles],dtype=np.int64).reshape(-1,3)
    triangles=coords[indices]
    meshes.append(dict(name=obj.name,tri=triangles,lo=triangles.min(axis=(0,1)) if len(triangles) else None,hi=triangles.max(axis=(0,1)) if len(triangles) else None))
    ev.to_mesh_clear()
print('UNITS',sc.unit_settings.system,sc.unit_settings.scale_length)
print('CURRENT_MESHES',[(m['name'],len(m['tri'])) for m in meshes])
print('INSTANCES',[(inst.object.name,inst.is_instance) for inst in deps.object_instances])
print('FUNCTION_AVAILABLE', 'tri_pair_distances' in globals())
print('FINITE',all(np.isfinite(m['tri']).all() for m in meshes))
print('DEGENERATE',[(m['name'],int(np.sum(np.linalg.norm(np.cross(m['tri'][:,1]-m['tri'][:,0],m['tri'][:,2]-m['tri'][:,0]),axis=1)==0))) for m in meshes])

threshold=.002/sc.unit_settings.scale_length
results=[]
for i,first in enumerate(meshes):
    for j in range(i+1,len(meshes)):
        second=meshes[j]
        if first['lo'] is None or second['lo'] is None: continue
        distance=float(tri_pair_distances(first['tri'],second['tri']).min())
        results.append((i,j,distance*1000*sc.unit_settings.scale_length))
qualifying=[(i,j,d) for i,j,d in results if d<=2]
zero=[(i,j,d) for i,j,d in qualifying if d==0]
positive=[(i,j,d) for i,j,d in qualifying if d>0]
print('COUNTS',len(meshes),sum(len(m['tri']) for m in meshes),len(results),len(qualifying),len(zero),len(positive))
print('ZERO_GROUPS')
for i in range(len(meshes)):
    partners=[meshes[j]['name'] for a,j,d in zero if a==i]
    if partners: print(meshes[i]['name'],', '.join(partners))
print('POSITIVE')
for i,j,d in positive: print(meshes[i]['name'],meshes[j]['name'],f'{d:.9f}')
print('NEAREST_THRESHOLD',sorted([(abs(d-2),meshes[i]['name'],meshes[j]['name'],d) for i,j,d in results])[:4])

import bpy, numpy as np
sc=bpy.context.scene
deps=bpy.context.evaluated_depsgraph_get()
meshes=[]
for obj in sc.objects:
    if obj.type!='MESH': continue
    ev=obj.evaluated_get(deps)
    mesh=ev.to_mesh()
    mesh.calc_loop_triangles()
    coords=np.array([tuple(v.co) for v in mesh.vertices],dtype=np.float64).reshape(-1,3)
    matrix=np.array(ev.matrix_world,dtype=np.float64)
    coords=coords@matrix[:3,:3].T+matrix[:3,3]
    indices=np.array([tuple(t.vertices) for t in mesh.loop_triangles],dtype=np.int64).reshape(-1,3)
    meshes.append(dict(name=obj.name,tri=coords[indices]))
    ev.to_mesh_clear()
print('UNITS',sc.unit_settings.system,sc.unit_settings.scale_length)
print('MESHES',[(m['name'],len(m['tri'])) for m in meshes])
print('EXTRA_INSTANCES',[(inst.object.name,inst.is_instance) for inst in deps.object_instances if inst.is_instance])
print('FUNCTION_AVAILABLE','tri_pair_distances' in globals())
print('FINITE',all(np.isfinite(m['tri']).all() for m in meshes))
print('EMPTY',[m['name'] for m in meshes if not len(m['tri'])])
print('DEGENERATE',[(m['name'],int(np.sum(np.linalg.norm(np.cross(m['tri'][:,1]-m['tri'][:,0],m['tri'][:,2]-m['tri'][:,0]),axis=1)==0))) for m in meshes if len(m['tri'])])
results=[]
for i,first in enumerate(meshes):
    for j in range(i+1,len(meshes)):
        second=meshes[j]
        if not len(first['tri']) or not len(second['tri']): continue
        distance=float(tri_pair_distances(first['tri'],second['tri']).min())
        results.append((i,j,distance*1000*sc.unit_settings.scale_length))
qualifying=[(i,j,d) for i,j,d in results if d<=2]
zero=[(i,j,d) for i,j,d in qualifying if d==0]
positive=[(i,j,d) for i,j,d in qualifying if d>0]
print('COUNTS',len(meshes),sum(len(m['tri']) for m in meshes),len(results),len(qualifying),len(zero),len(positive))
print('ZERO_GROUPS')
for i in range(len(meshes)):
    partners=[meshes[j]['name'] for a,j,d in zero if a==i]
    if partners: print(meshes[i]['name'],', '.join(partners))
print('POSITIVE')
for i,j,d in positive: print(meshes[i]['name'],meshes[j]['name'],f'{d:.9f}')
print('NEAREST_THRESHOLD',sorted([(abs(d-2),meshes[i]['name'],meshes[j]['name'],d) for i,j,d in results])[:4])

zero=[(i,j,d) for i,j,d in qualifying if d==0]
positive=[(i,j,d) for i,j,d in qualifying if d>0]
print('COUNTS',len(meshes),sum(len(m['tri']) for m in meshes),len(results),len(qualifying),len(zero),len(positive))

for i in range(len(meshes)):
